scope: Actual resident agentctl: optional intra-prefill deferred synchronization

rows.actions: scripted Native-parser choices; real agentctl/tool execution

method.residency: one model process; reset session only between independent tasks; no KV save/evict/restore
method.receipt: both off/on body-first then final status footer; default CLI legacy layout unchanged
method.workload: three real test.run calls plus four real Native prepare/first-greedy/actions through CLI REPL and AgentStore; fixed Native-parser tool choices;8 plain lines; actual words/iterations recorded on every row
method.order: One warmup per case/mode then seven evaluations, rotate modes; three producer-alone controls before each case/rep with model idle. No concurrent performance/build/test.
method.metrics: CLI tick wall including tools, transcript assembly, Native and numeric logs; exact post-token independent tokenizer oracle measured separately and subtracted; raw wall retained
method.excluded: model load, helper first/warm execution, per-task ordinary Native reset; no build optimization
method.trace: Private owner-only trace defaults off; this harness enables it. Decode call wall/owner CPU and explicit following synchronization wall/owner CPU recorded separately; not pure device times.
method.scheduler: proc_pid_rusage RUSAGE_INFO_V4 raw Mach runnable/CPU counters plus timebase; runnable includes running. ready=(runnable-CPU)*timebase, blocked=wall-runnable*timebase are coarse proxies with accounting lag; negative values retained. Producer setup/compute/output spans and context-switch/instruction/cycle counts; child end precedes sidecar IO/exit.
method.policies: Exit-race corrected throughout. off/idle/thread/growth controls as E36. E39 off-drain/growth-drain only defer explicit synchronization inside one prefill loop; every public return drained, greedy and failure synchronize. Strict remains default.

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; real CLI/tool execution, not autonomous model planning or full output generation
Tools bounded retained4096 bytes; test.run(empty args) and verified Qwen3 template only; full render/prefix guard remains
No snapshots, evictions, disk-KV transfer, memory capacity win, cloud SSE or Windows/CUDA acceptance
No evaluation tuning; all warmup/evaluation pairs and negative results retained; per-task reset/model-resident workload only

Synchronization wall is waiting for outstanding work plus host scheduling; no Metal kernel start/end timestamps. Decode may internally wait, so a decrease in explicit synchronization may just move time.

Runnable accounting has update lag; do not force negative proxies to zero or equate every non-CPU millisecond with runqueue wait. Producer-alone proves a background scheduling mechanism exists, not the cause of every historical outlier.
No outlier deletion or evaluation tuning. Seven pairs do not establish p95/p99. No physical KV reduction or Windows/CUDA acceptance.

default_regression.scope: Final source; E38 earlier instrumented source archived independently

validation.failure_injection: No artificial llama_decode failure or thread-constructor OOM injected; existing capacity/error/timeout/cancel oracles retained

calibration.scope: Separate CPU100ms busy versus sleep100ms unit calibration, not main LLM timing rows; verifies raw tick conversion, retains runnable counter lag.
